summary.name: Imajinn AI Couple Portrait Canvas
summary.one_liner: An AI service that turns uploaded photos of a couple into painted-style portraits, printed as a canvas, framed print, or poster for gifting.
use_cases: Gifting a custom couple portrait to a partner
Replacing a caricature artist or painter commission
Creating wall art from couple photos
Making a personalized AI children's book for a child
summary.what_it_does: The service takes 3-5 uploaded photos of a couple and generates hundreds of AI-painted romantic portraits across 40+ art style presets. The user picks a favorite, and the print is shipped in 5-14 days. Print options named on the page are a matte or semi-glossy paper poster, a wood framed canvas, or a poster mounted in a wood or metal frame. The page also advertises an AI children's book made from a child's photos and an AI Photobooth for individual portraits and profile pictures. It states that uploaded photos are processed securely and automatically deleted after the portrait is created.
notable: Generates hundreds of portraits in 40+ art styles from 3-5 couple photos
Physical delivery as canvas, framed print, or mounted poster
Photos automatically deleted after portrait creation, per the page
Related AI children's book and photobooth products
caveats: Physical prints are shipped, taking 5-14 days
Page advertises a limited-time 20% new-customer discount (WELCOME20), so listed prices are not stated on the page
Pricing amounts are not shown in the page text
